description:
Noel Kelly Auctioneers are delighted to bring no.19 River View to the market. This well presented 4-bedroom detached property is ideally positioned in a quiet cul de sac in a boutique development of just 26 family homes. Built in 2023 this energy efficient home has been lavished with care and attention by its current owners.

The accommodation briefly comprises of an entrance hall, spacious living room, guest wc, fully fitted kitchen/dining area with a utility room off, and further living space with doors to a private rear garden. Upstairs there are 4 spacious bedrooms with a master ensuite and a family bathroom both with pressurised systems. The rear garden boasts a sunny west facing rear garden with a large patio and 2 side entrances.
There is an ample selection of schools nearby, and the property is convenient to Swords and all leisure, transport and shopping amenities. Dublin Airport and the M1 /M50 motorways are close by.
